question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
-- Let me refine the output types to match the expected format exactly
-- avg_inter_movie_duration as INTEGER, total_votes as INTEGER, total_duration as INTEGER
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id, m.id as movie_id, m.date_published, m.duration
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
director_with_prev AS (
    SELECT name_id, movie_id, date_published, duration,
           LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_gaps AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           date_diff('day', prev_date, date_published) as gap_days
    FROM director_with_prev
    WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
),
director_avg_gap AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           AVG(gap_days) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM inter_movie_gaps
    GROUP BY name_id
),
director_base AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           COUNT(*) as movie_count,
           SUM(duration) as total_duration
    FROM director_movies
    GROUP BY name_id
),
director_ratings AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id,
           AVG(r.avg_rating) as avg_rating,
           SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
           MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
           MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id
)
SELECT 
    db.name_id as director_id,
    n.name as director_name,
    CAST(db.movie_count AS INTEGER) as movie_count,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(dag.avg_inter_movie_duration, 0)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(COALESCE(dr.avg_rating, 0), 2) as avg_rating,
    CAST(dr.total_votes AS BIGINT) as total_votes,
    dr.min_rating,
    dr.max_rating,
    CAST(db.total_duration AS INTEGER) as total_duration
FROM director_base db
JOIN names n ON db.name_id = n.id
LEFT JOIN director_avg_gap dag ON db.name_id = dag.name_id
LEFT JOIN director_ratings dr ON db.name_id = dr.name_id
ORDER BY db.movie_count DESC, db.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

The movies table connects to the ratings, director_mapping, genre, and role_mapping tables via movies.id to ratings.movie_id, director_mapping.movie_id, genre.movie_id, and role_mapping.movie_id. The names table connects to the director_mapping and role_mapping tables via names.id to director_mapping.name_id and role_mapping.name_id.
